_doc.about: Whether new mail lands in a bundle, for the server's choice not to notify about bundled mail. Run by shared/src/bundles.spec.ts; functions imports the same code.
_doc.cases: arrivalBundleLabels(labels, bundleOff) is labels: the thread's user labels (ids starting Label_) and categories other than Primary, without those in bundleOff, in order; none when the thread is starred (a thread with a todo bundles like any other). bundledOnArrival(labels, bundleOff) is bundled: it has any of those labels, however many inbox threads carry it (even this one alone).
_doc.wake: bundledOnWake(labels, pinned, bundleLabels) is bundled: a thread or todo coming back from its snooze counts as bundled when it isn't pinned and one of labels (a thread's own, or those a todo's tags name) is in bundleLabels (those that bundle), however many items carry it. Run by shared/src/bundles.spec.ts and Android :core (ArrivalBundleFixturesTest).

cases.name: a user label bundles, though no other inbox thread has it
a category other than Primary bundles like a user label
Primary and system labels never bundle
a label with bundling off doesn't count

a thread with a todo bundles like any other

a todo naming no label doesn't
any one of several labels that bundles is enough
